cc:Work.dc:title: Eligible dataset coverage
cc:Work.dc:description: Selected full-coverage models, Russian rules, Presidio, and all ten scanner configurations. A missing measurement is not a zero-miss result.

g.text: Coverage is part of the result

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50647a

g.text: Eligible base-configuration datasets / available datasets | training-source overlaps excluded

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #50647a

g.text: This is measurement coverage, not detection quality. A zero can mean missing runs or excluded source overlap.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #50647a

g.text: Scanners have a narrower intended scope. See the full per-dataset reports before comparing unequal subsets.
